117:t_1:86.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(You're the one to go, $n. Go and hear what's on Miss $$スズネ$$'s mind.)

117:t_1:87.en:
$n
(You don't have to tell me. I was planning to.)

117:t_1:88.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(You'd have shied away before, but now you're taking the initiative.)

117:t_1:89.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(Did the happy $$コーラサワー$$ inspire you or something?)

117:t_1:92.en:
$n
(I want to know more about Miss $$スズネ$$... We're partners, and yet I don't know anything about her.)

117:t_1:93.en:
$$刹那$$
(Trying to know someone... I think thinking about the other person is important.)

117:t_1:94.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Good luck, $n. If Miss $$スズネ$$, our mood-maker, is feeling down, it affects morale on our side too.)

117:t_1:95.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What's going on, everyone? Are you trying to recruit $n into $$ソレスタルビーイング$$?」

117:t_1:96.en:
$n
「If that happened, would you come along too, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

117:t_1:97.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What should I do...? If that happened, I'd have to give up my dream of being a teacher...」

117:t_1:98.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But I can't just leave $n alone. We're partners, after all.」

117:t_1:99.en:
$n
「Then tell me too, please. What went through your mind when $$オーティス$$ came up earlier.」

117:t_1:101.en:
$n
「Ah... I mean... I'm not trying to force you or anything...」

117:t_1:102.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(What are you doing...! How can you be that timid!?)

117:t_1:103.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Keep quiet, $$ロックオン$$.)

117:t_1:105.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(Looking at $n, it seems my short-straw blood is stirring.)

117:t_1:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We are partners, aren't we... I really should tell you what's in my heart...」

117:t_1:109.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I told you before that I came from a world that's neither $$ＵＣＷ$$ nor $$ＡＤＷ$$, didn't I?」

117:t_1:111.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The truth is... I hardly remember anything from there...」

117:t_1:113.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I remembered my name was $$西条$$ $$スズネ$$, but I couldn't really tell which kanji I used to write it, either...」

117:t_1:114.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And among the few memories I have, there was a view of a town attacked by $$次元獣$$s, just like that $$オーティス$$...」

117:t_1:115.en:
$n
「So you ran into $$次元獣$$s, Miss $$スズネ$$...」

117:t_1:116.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I don't know whether that was my own experience... But when I heard about $$オーティス$$, I couldn't think of it as someone else's problem...」

117:t_1:119.en:
$n
「If you can't think of it as someone else's problem, then think of it as your hometown and let's liberate $$オーティス$$.」

117:t_1:121.en:
$$スズネ$$
「For $$エスター$$... and for myself, too, I will save that town...」

117:t_1:123.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... you stole my big line, didn't you.」

117:t_1:124.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(All right...! All right! Well done, $n...!)

117:t_1:125.en:
$$刹那$$
(So that is what it means to understand each other...)

117:t_1:126.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(Then shall we make ourselves scarce?)

117:t_1:127.en:
$$マリー$$
(Yes. It would be rude to get in their way.)

117:t_1:128.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Let us also fight with all our strength to liberate $$オーティス$$.)

117:t_1:129.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Thank you, $n. Thanks to you, I was able to make up my mind.」

117:t_1:130.en:
$n
「Have I become a little more like a proper partner?」

117:t_1:131.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We still have a long way to go, though, both of us.」

117:t_1:132.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Thank you, $n... I'm sure that someday we'll become true partners...)

117:t_1:133.en:
$$スズネ$$
(So when that time comes, tell me. Everything you're holding inside your heart...)

117:t_2:3.en: ～ $$オーティス$$ $$ターミナル・ベース$$ ～

117:t_2:4.en:
$n
「...Thank you, Lieutenant $$パトリック$$. You've been a big help.」

117:t_2:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Don't mention it. You and I are in the Older-Beauty-with-Glasses Lovers' Alliance, after all.」

117:t_2:6.en:
$n
「Since when am I on that team...!?」

117:t_2:7.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Huh... it looked like you and Miss $$スズネ$$ had a good mood going today, though.」

117:t_2:8.en:
$$マリー$$
「Don't tease him too much, $$アレルヤ$$. $n has a sweetheart elsewhere, after all.」

117:t_2:9.en:
$n
「Ah... that part... it doesn't matter anymore...」

117:t_2:11.en:
$n
「I haven't been able to get in touch lately...」

117:t_2:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So it just fizzled out...」

117:t_2:13.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Sorry, $n. I didn't know it was like that...」

117:t_2:14.en:
$n
「Please don't worry about it. Right now...」

117:t_2:15.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Crazy about an older beauty with glasses?」

117:t_2:16.en:
$n
「That's not it...! Right now I'm trying to focus on the fighting...」

117:t_2:17.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Just kidding. Well... it's true that from now on we're comrades fighting together. I'm counting on you, $c.」

117:t_2:18.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I welcome you, Lieutenant $$パトリック・マネキン$$.」

117:t_2:19.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Being called by my full name isn't bad. It really makes me feel like I'm married.」

117:t_2:20.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「He's as frank as ever.」

117:t_2:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you still feel uneasy about facing $$刹那$$?」

117:t_2:24.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I still cannot hold my head high as the being I am.」

117:t_2:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I've heard about you from $$ゼクス$$. From now on, I'd like to ask you to assist with command of the unit.」

117:t_2:26.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I have no intention of saying it is above my station. I humbly accept.」

117:t_2:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then I'm counting on you, Major $$グラハム$$.」

117:t_2:29.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Done with the greetings, $$グラハム・エーカー$$? Then let's go see $$刹那$$.」

117:t_2:30.en:
$$グラハム$$
「My apologies... I am still...」

117:t_2:31.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Still can't make up your mind? You're like a pure-hearted boy with an unrequited crush.」

117:t_2:32.en:
$$グラハム$$
「An unrequited crush... A fitting description.」

117:t_2:33.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Well, fine. Go all out until you're satisfied with yourself.」

117:t_2:34.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But here's some advice from the guy who won over an unattainable beauty. If you keep on longing, your feelings will surely get through.」

kept_omissions: 117:t_1:115: 'So you ran into Dimensional Beasts, Miss Suzune' - addressed to her directly (Hibiki is replying to her story).
117:t_2:11: 'I haven't been able to get in touch lately' - the other party (the sweetheart) is unnamed and of unknown gender, kept unstated.
117:t_2:34: 'your feelings will surely get through' - recipient left unstated (Setsuna, named in 29, is the object of Graham's feeling; no pronoun needed).
uncertain: 117:t_2:7: Allelujah's 'good mood today' read as Hibiki and Miss Suzune (the preceding scene, and Cola's older-beauty-with-glasses alliance joke); the Japanese names no one.
117:t_2:9: 'そっちは、もういいんです' rendered ambiguously ('that part... it doesn't matter anymore') since Lockon takes it as a breakup and Hibiki then explains lost contact.
117:t_2:5/15: 年上メガネ美人好き同盟 = 'Older-Beauty-with-Glasses Lovers' Alliance' (route-A 2015_01 uses 'older beauties with glasses').

117:t_1:113: サイジョウスズネ (katakana, no kanji) rendered '$$西条$$ $$スズネ$$' (= Saijou Suzune, Japanese order, as the line is about the kanji she can't recall) rather than the full-name token $$西条涼音$$ (Suzune Saijou).
117:t_1:122/123: 私…じゃなくて、俺達です = 'Not I... we'; 決め台詞 rendered 'big line' (Suzune's closing line that Hibiki 'stole'); whose catchphrase is not stated in the Japanese.
117:t_2:20: Allelujah's 'フランクな人だね' rendered third-person 'He's as frank as ever' (could be addressed to Cola).
117:t_2:17: よろしく頼むぜ rendered 'I'm counting on you, $c' (Cola, the newcomer, asking the squad).
117:t_1:89: 幸せのコーラサワー = 'the happy Colasour' (married to Kati); 117:t_2:27 Major = 少佐 (rank table not settled).
Parenthesised thoughts (...) kept as in the Japanese even though characters whisper to each other (rows 86-94, 124-128).
